description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5315011514180 PIN,STRAIGHT,HEADLE: Line 0001 Qty 1061 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0116 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
